subject: attn
title: (R)ATTN.------C.CONT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 108 (T(AF)M-12). ATTN (attraction) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and DEF (definition), with the (R) prefix. From DEF: EXT-DY (extended dynamics). From EXT-DY: INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From INFO-AF-B: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, is on a dotted line from INFO-AF-B.
